summary.text: Dwight Evans represents Pennsylvania's 3rd Congressional District, covering parts of Philadelphia, and was first elected in a November 2016 special election.

paragraphs.text: Before Congress he was a Pennsylvania state representative and the first African-American chairman of the state House Appropriations Committee.
He serves on the House Ways and Means Committee, is a graduate of Germantown High School, the Community College of Philadelphia and LaSalle University, and is a lifelong Philadelphia resident.
